description: This Java class 'PageStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods to analyze books in the 'read' shelf, such as finding the book with the most pages and calculating the average page length, leveraging the 'Book' model and a predefined shelf service.

classes.name: PageStatistics
classes.description: A class that provides statistics related to pages of books in the 'read' shelf, including finding the book with the most pages and calculating average page length.

methods.name: findBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest number of pages from the 'read' shelf.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLength
methods.description: Calculates the average number of pages for books in the 'read' shelf that have page counts specified.

methods.name: findBooksWithPageCountSpecified
methods.description: Filters the 'read' shelf books to include only those with a non-null page count.
